Hi all! This is TeacherShiba.

I did not write any notes of several updates recently.

notes.title: Full Release at 20th June!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044047/3ee713e15f698326d58678dd9d434afb94abf0ee.png[/img]

Finally, we are getting out of early access and going to full release.
It has been a year and 2 months, what a long time.

Now we have a full-dubbed version with Korean voice actresses.

[previewyoutube=bc_8Qzig7k0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your interest, even we still do not have an English version yet.

notes.title: 『TastyLove』 Streaming Guidelines
notes.notes:
We do condone live-streaming our games at length so long as the video is not archived or uploaded elsewhere. However, we strongly ask that you refrain from streaming the final chapters of the game or its character routes in order to encourage fans to purchase the game themselves. Uploaded or archived video falls under the following policy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044047/177a313772a4d9e721f427fb490e5cfa2f4f5e10.png[/img]

Users are permitted to upload and share video of any or all content featured [b]before the warning screen.[/b] Further game content may be uploaded so long as it limited to non-sequential clips which are no more than a few minutes long. These clips may be arranged together in longer videos for the purpose of creating a video review. We DO NOT condone uploading a play-through video or sequence of videos which cover our games from start to finish.
